WITH RECURSIVE 
		notes_with_INCLUSION_tags
		AS (
			SELECT note_tags.note_id as id
			FROM note_tags
			WHERE
			1 INTERSECT
			
	SELECT note_tags.note_id AS id
	FROM note_tags
	WHERE note_tags.tag_id IN (
	SELECT tags.id
	FROM tags
	WHERE tags.title
	LIKE ?) INTERSECT 
	SELECT note_tags.note_id AS id
	FROM note_tags
	WHERE note_tags.tag_id IN (
	SELECT tags.id
	FROM tags
	WHERE tags.title
	LIKE ?)
		) 
	SELECT
	notes.id,
	notes.title,
	
	notes.user_created_time,
	notes.user_updated_time,
	notes.is_todo,
	notes.todo_completed,
	notes.parent_id
	FROM notes
	WHERE 1 
	AND ROWID 
	IN (
		SELECT notes.ROWID
		FROM notes_with_INCLUSION_tags
		JOIN notes
		ON notes_with_INCLUSION_tags.id=notes.id
	)

		SELECT folders.id
		FROM folders
		WHERE id
		IN (
			SELECT id
			FROM folders
			WHERE folders.title LIKE ?
		)
